model_role: Primary Deep-Learning Preliminary Flood Segmentation Model

training_configuration.loss_function: MaskedBCEDiceLoss (50% BCE + 50% Dice with nodata 255 masking)

somalia_validation_results.note: Reported Somalia metrics represent validation results on the Sen1Floods11 benchmark split and DO NOT represent Nepal event accuracy.
somalia_validation_results.evaluation_partition: Somalia validation tiles (4 tiles: Somalia_028, Somalia_029, Somalia_030, Somalia_031)

safeguards: SAR change detection and model predictions represent preliminary probabilistic evidence, not definitive proof of ground flooding or structural damage.
Model outputs must not be used solely to claim road closures, settlement access limitations, or area safety status without ground verification.
Somalia validation metrics reflect performance on Sen1Floods11 validation tiles and must not be cited as Nepal operational accuracy.
EMSR927 activation data and Nepal event masks were kept strictly isolated from training, tuning, and checkpoint selection.
